SELECT * FROM ( -- 1. 일반 주문 (구매확정) SELECT u.name AS customerName, si.item_name AS productName, '구매확정' AS status, o.paid_at AS orderDate, si.price AS amount FROM `cors`.`orders` o JOIN `cors`.`order_items` oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` si ON oi.item_id = si.id LEFT JOIN `cors`.`users` u ON o.user_email = u.email WHERE oi.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.status = 'PAID' AND oi.status = '4'
UNION ALL
-- 2. 예약 (거래완료) SELECT u.name AS customerName, si.item_name AS productName, '거래완료' AS status, r.updated_at AS orderDate, si.price AS amount FROM `cors`.`reservations` r JOIN `cors`.`reservation_items` ri ON r.id = ri.reservation_id JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` si ON ri.item_id = si.id LEFT JOIN `cors`.`users` u ON r.user_email = u.email WHERE r.shop_id = #{shopId} AND r.status = '완료' ) AS combined_payments WHERE orderDate >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1) DAY) AND orderDate < DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY orderDate DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(si.price) AS sales, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS orderCount FROM `cors`.`reservations` r JOIN `cors`.`reservation_items` ri ON r.id = ri.reservation_id JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` si ON ri.item_id = si.id WHERE r.shop_id = #{shopId} AND r.status = '완료'
AND r.updated_at >= #{startDate} AND r.updated_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
